$comment: Necessary but not sufficient: decimal bounds (x-gie-*), canonical order, cross-field invariants (x-gie-invariants), lifecycle rules (x-gie-behaviour), exact 64-bit integer tokens and printable-text rules are enforced by the reference implementation gie.contracts.

NamedValue.description: A named number (feature value or metric).  ``null`` means unknown, never 0.

value.description: Finite numeric value; null when the value is unknown.

PriceCondition.description: Observable price condition: the basis price compared with a level.

timeframe.description: Candle timeframe when basis is CANDLE_CLOSE, otherwise null.

trigger.description: Comparison that makes the condition true.

x-gie-invariants.rule: timeframe is a candle timeframe if and only if basis is CANDLE_CLOSE

PriceLevel.description: A price with a role, e.g. the swept level or the bounds of a fair value gap.

identity.description: True when the level is part of the market event's identity (it then never changes between revisions and all engines must report the same value).

role.description: Role of the level from the feature dictionary (e.g. SWEPT_LEVEL, FVG_HIGH, PENDING_LIMIT).

description: Directional observation with scores, levels, stage, freshness and invalidation.

anchor_time_ns.description: Source event time that pins the market event (part of its identity).

as_of_time_ns.description: Market-data watermark: receive time of the newest market data the record depends on, directly or through its inputs.

bearish_score.description: Strength of evidence that the instrument falls; null only when MISSING.

bullish_score.description: Strength of evidence that the instrument rises; null only when MISSING.

contradicts_market_event_ids.description: Market events this observation speaks against; non-empty if and only if state is CONTRA.

data_origin.description: Least trustworthy origin among the market data the record is derived from.

decision_time_ns.description: Clock reading at which the producer created the record.

engine.description: Producing engine.  For STRATEGY_ENGINE one of the six canonical engine ids.

features.description: Engine-specific features from the feature dictionary.  A feature that is absent or null is unknown, never 0.

invalidation.description: Price condition that invalidates the observation, if one exists.  The producer evaluates it and emits an INVALIDATED revision; consumers do not re-evaluate it.

kind.description: Evidence kind from the feature dictionary (e.g. liquidity_sweep, fair_value_gap, breakout).

market_event_id.description: Identity of the observed market event, shared by all engines that observe it (exact de-duplication).  INACTIVE and MISSING records carry the engine's evaluation-slot id instead.

missing_reason.description: Why the producer could not evaluate; set if and only if state is MISSING.

mode.description: REPLAY or PAPER.  No live mode exists (routing lock).

observable_time_ns.description: Receive time of the input from which this revision's state could first be determined. decision_time_ns - observable_time_ns is the notification delay.

producer.description: Component instance that emitted the record; together with the contract name it names the stream.

related_market_event_id.description: Market event this observation follows from (for a pending limit: the breakout it belongs to).

revision.description: 0 for the first record of an observation, +1 per update.

run_id.description: Run that produced the record (see the RunManifest of that run).

schema_version.description: Version of the contract the message was written with.

seq.description: Position of the record in its stream: starts at 0 and increases by exactly 1.

state.description: Evaluation state of the producer's condition.

supersedes_evidence_id.description: Previous revision replaced by this record; null for revision 0.

symbol.description: Instrument the observation is about (scores and levels refer to it).

timeframe.description: Timeframe the observation was made on; NONE when it is not tied to a candle.

valid_until_ns.description: Expiry instant: the evidence must not be used at or after it.

title: Evidence 1.0.0

identity.market_event_id: market_event_id(kind, symbol, timeframe, anchor_time_ns, identity level prices); evaluation_slot_id(engine, kind, symbol, timeframe, anchor_time_ns) for INACTIVE and MISSING

monotonic: identity levels and market_event_id never change between revisions

x-gie-invariants.rule: as_of_time_ns <= decision_time_ns (a record cannot depend on data received after it was created)

market_event_id equals identity.market_event_id(kind, symbol, timeframe, anchor_time_ns, prices of identity levels); for INACTIVE and MISSING it equals identity.evaluation_slot_id(engine, kind, symbol, timeframe, anchor_time_ns)
state is MISSING if and only if both scores are null; otherwise both scores are numbers
missing_reason is set if and only if state is MISSING
when state is INACTIVE, INVALIDATED or EXPIRED both scores are exactly 0
contradicts_market_event_ids is non-empty if and only if state is CONTRA, and never contains the record's own market_event_id
supersedes_evidence_id is null for revision 0 and otherwise equals the id of the previous revision, identity.evidence_id(engine, market_event_id, revision - 1)
when state is ACTIVE or CONTRA, valid_until_ns is later than decision_time_ns
a STRATEGY_ENGINE producer is one of the six canonical engines and observes XAUUSD
INACTIVE and MISSING records describe no market event: stage is NONE, there are no identity levels and no related market event
observable_time_ns <= as_of_time_ns (the state cannot have been observable later than the newest data the record uses)
an ACTIVE record of kind pending_limit has exactly one PENDING_LIMIT level, exactly one score greater than 0 (bullish = buy limit) and names the breakout in related_market_event_id
levels and invalidation of an XAUUSD observation are prices greater than 0
